Tras el asesinato de Valentín Elizalde, comienza la investigación. Pronto, la familia del cantante viaja para recuperar los cuerpos y trasladarlos de regreso a Sonora.

Desde una maldición china que resulta ser real, hasta restos humanos en el sótano de un Padre Fundador estadounidense, y una misteriosa isla en Asia Central con suficientes patógenos para acabar varias veces con la población mundial. Los descubrimientos accidentales más mortales del mundo.

Los ladrones calculadores atacan a una familia que realiza una compra especial de joyas. Las gasolineras se convierten en zonas de peligro cuando los delincuentes atacan a conductores inocentes en el surtidor.

Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Ross develops a skin growth that doctors cannot identify the cause of. Phoebe finds herself in a dilemma when she cannot choose between two guys, and Monica's boyfriend surprises her by not proposing.

Monica finds herself dating a guy who wants to be the Ultimate Fighting Champion. Meanwhile, Chandler finds his male boss's attentions just a little too friendly, and the group overhear a scandalous conversation at Central Perk.

Phoebe invites everyone to stay at her massage client's beach house for the weekend. Phoebe meets someone who knows details about her family, Rachel expresses her jealousy of Ross' uninhibited girlfriend, and Joey nags the friends into agreeing to play a party game that requires the participants to gradually take off items of clothing.
Ross has married Emily, but during the reception she punches him and flees. Meanwhile, new lovers Monica and Chandler are finding it hard to keep their agreement.

BAFTA award-winning comedian Michael McIntyre returns with a brand-new episode of his Big Show, for an unmissable night of family entertainment at London's prestigious Theatre Royal Drury Lane. Holly Willoughby plays new game Remember Me, Perrie Edwards is awoken for an epic Midnight game show, McFly v Busted give a spectacular performance, and a heartwarming Unexpected Star of the Show gets the surprise of their life.
Michael McIntyre hosts as Dermot O'Leary, Dame Jessica Ennis-Hill, Roman Kemp, Adam Kay, Angela Scanlon, Kay Burley and Alex Brooker try to help the contestants answer their way to a fortune.
Ross's new wife won't speak to him, Rachel appoints Monica her adviser in romance, and Phoebe feels neglected.
Phoebe prepares to give birth, but the doctor makes her nervous, Joey experiences his own pain, and Monica plans to go out on a date with a male nurse to spite Chandler.

Joey challenges Phoebe to perform a completely selfless act, Monica gets upset when Chandler gloats about sex, and Ross has a chance to get back together with Emily, but first he must make a tough decision.

As the gang digests Monica's huge Thanksgiving meal, everyone reminisces about their worst Thanksgiving ever.

After returning from another disappointing audition, Joey tries to write a play in which he can star. Meanwhile, Rachel gets a date with her neighbour Danny, but is perturbed to discover his extremely intimate relationship with his sexy sister.
The friends make their New Year resolutions, and Joey tries to arrange for Chandler to kiss Monica at midnight at a New Year's Eve party.

Monica is annoyed when she discovers Chandler is ingratiating himself with his new boss Doug. He even has a fake laugh which he uses whenever Doug cracks a joke. Meanwhile, Rachel is obsessed with finding out the gossip between Monica and Chandler after overhearing a sexy conversation between them, and Ross astounds everyone with his new girlfriend, a blast from the past.
Mr Bean goes to the funfair and is surprised to discover that he has become a babysitter. Luckily, the mother finds them in time.
Mr Bean goes back to school where he takes part in a science demonstration, attends an art class and learns the finer points of judo.
Mr Bean goes to the launderette where he loses his trousers once again. He then plays a round of mini golf but has trouble keeping his ball on the green.
Mr Bean has a hard time waiting his turn at the hospital, later he visits Windsor Castle and, that night, has trouble with a bit of insomnia.

Veteran police detective Roger Murtaugh is only days away from retiring when he and his tough partner, Martin Riggs, are roped into an important internal affairs case. Working with the beautiful, no-nonsense Sergeant Lorna Cole and aided by the shifty informant Leo Getz, Murtaugh and Riggs begin to close in on a black-market weapons operation involving corrupt cop and arms dealer Jack Travis.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A judge gets temporarily suspended after making a teenager wear handcuffs and prison garb after falling asleep in court; a man arrested for stalking hurls insults at the prosecutor.
A man charged with murder attempts a bold escape, a lawyer is attacked by his own client, a man blames his pet for cursing at a judge, and more.
The judge moves a probation review to her courtroom after the defendant appears drunk for his virtual hearing; a defendant gets thrown out of the courtroom after talking back to the judge.

A convicted woman flees the courtroom after being sentenced to jail time; a grieving man confronts the convict who killed his son in prison; the judge is hard on a carnival worker who's behind on her child support payments; and more.

A grieving father asks the judge for leniency for his son who's been convicted of murdering his other son; a senior citizen spends the night in jail after continually interrupting the judge; a grieving man is removed from the courtroom.

The brothers of a woman murdered by her daughter confront the defendant, their niece, in court. An annoyed defendant walks out of a virtual hearing, a man convicted of manslaughter refuses to look at the grieving grandmother of his victim, and more.

A judge chastises a defendant for his courtroom outburst; a convicted murderer's mother tells the court that she used methamphetamine with him the day he shot his boss; A defendant threatens to sue the judge after an unfavourable decision.

After a failed plea for leniency, an angry mother flips the bird to the media after her son is sentenced; a grieving woman begs the judge to keep her brother in prison; a judge must use his mute button to silence a foul-mouthed mum.

A convicted felon tries to escape while being ushered back to jail; the judge changes a defendant's sentence after she catches him lying in court; a man accused of indecent exposure is held in contempt after swearing at the judge; and more.

A maskless defendant tells the judge he's tested positive for tuberculosis; a grieving son forgives the woman responsible for his parents' deaths; a convicted murderer removed from the courtroom for smiling during a Victim Impact Statement.
A man hurls furniture onto a busy NYC street from atop a skyscraper; a passenger allegedly tries to sneak onto a full flight; a self-proclaimed bride is arrested for DUI on her supposed wedding day.
A naked man makes a scene on a Miami Beach, a drunk driver finds a strange and dangerous place to relieve himself, and the mayor of a Minnesota town finds himself in police custody.
A man drives through a store after having trashed it; a Florida neighbourhood falls victim to shocking deliveries; a beach-goer causes mayhem after breaking free from a police car.

Hunters discover the body of a woman in the Georgia woods. As detectives launch a homicide investigation, attention turns to her husband, a former Navy lawyer, whose account raises more questions than answers.
Police are hard-pressed to find solid leads when a 19-year-old girl.

After a barrage of gunfire leaves three men dead in a residential neighbourhood, Gwinnett detectives use every available resource to identify the killer. But at trial, the defendant claims he acted in self-defence.
Heather Elvis vanishes after calls from an ex-partner, leaving behind a locked car and unanswered questions.
In his first ever televised interview, Gary Michael Hilton, the oldest serial killer in American history, comes clean about his crimes.
A little-known serial killer terrorises Riverside, California, targeting vulnerable women. As the attacks continue, police face a desperate race to uncover the man responsible.
When a predator targets minors, police plan a takedown as chilling messages expose a pattern of behaviour and an undercover decoy lures him in.
Live feed from Mecca every day that would enlighten our viewers by bringing visuals live from Islam's Holiest.
Melodious recitation of the Holy Qur'an with English translation.
Examines the companions of the Holy Prophet, their exemplary life, and example.
Lecture titled 'Good and Evil, is it all from Allah?' delivered by Faraz Khan.
The history and compilation of the Qur'an.
A lecture series by Ml. Farouk Soofie. The focus is manners and behaviour acceptable to societal Norms.
Documentary on Neanderthals, an extinct species of humans. The documentary looks into the scientific study of these beings of the past.
Ntokozo Hlongwane talks to an inspired audience in Durban, City Hall about How To Pass Matric With Maximum Distinctions, his highly influential book which has sent matric pass rates through the roof.
A palaeontology documentary on Dinosaurs. The focus is on Spinosaurus aegyptiacus.
Lecture on the control of one's inhibitions and becoming an internal activist in the quest for spiritual attainment.
Lecture on the importance of managing one's time.

Dr Jeff tackles challenging surgeries on a pit bull with a broken leg and a feisty kitten's torn lower lip. Dr Amy treats a dog that's acting sickly after a camping trip. Dr Don handles a bladder stone removal on vet tech Christine's family pet.

When Redbeard challenges Heavy D to repurpose some old inventory, Heavy decides to marry a stretched six-door F650 with a camper to create the ultimate expedition vehicle. The guys buy a Hummer H1 from a mysterious mountain man.
The crew race to finish a six-door stretched F650 Expedition Camper for a big client. Heavy D shocks the guys with a diesel-powered experimental helicopter.
The Diesel Sellerz aim to turn a vintage fire truck into a tow truck that can carry big numbers, and the legendary Chuck Norris needs a truck for his latest project.
The guys grab a vintage fire truck to convert into a tow truck to carry everyone in the shop. Heavy D must finish the endless Fail of the Year UTV build.
Heavy D builds a somersaulting truck for viral videos. Meanwhile, The Muscle takes over a flip from Heavy D and turns a Dodge Ram into a funky modern pop-up camper.
The guys race the clock for their SEMA build, a replica Ford Bronco made from an F350 and an Excursion. Heavy D aims to make a somersaulting truck a reality.
Rick prospects new ground on Duncan Creek; Tony tasks Nick to deliver their biggest haul of the year; Buzz finds a feeder to increase production.

Chase and the team seek to transform a family's 1950s lobster shack into a cabin, that will create a lifetime of memories for generations to come. They re-imagine the cabin's interior layout, preserve a mural and add an exterior widow's walk.
A Georgia couple is ready to tackle their next off-grid build: the ultimate watchtower guest house in the Blue Ridge Mountains; building 30 feet off the ground presents its challenges.

Two scout teams attempt gruelling journeys to reach a signal tower. One team struggles to crest a jungle ridgeline, and the other takes on 12 miles of Lost Coast seas. And a survivalist slips out of consciousness.

There's no such thing as a regular day at Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic. Dr. Jeff Young and his team represent one last hope and possibly the difference between life and death for beloved pets and wild animals.
A client wants a German half-track armoured personnel carrier converted into a Pioneer variant, used by the German army during the Battle of the Bulge.

In this episode, Henry and Sam are uncovering vintage treasures in West Sussex. They go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and in its dark corners and dusty attics find two extraordinary hidden gems.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. In this episode, the pair are in Herefordshire where they discover some amazing sheds full of engines, autogyros and weird and wonderful vehicles of all kinds. Eventually, they come away with a British classic before driving on to Gloucestershire. There they find a picturesque farm where deer, goats and pigs, rub shoulders with some vintage agricultural equipment.

Today the boys are driving on to Gloucestershire to uncover some oily treasure. They find a picturesque farm where deer, goats and pigs rub shoulders with vintage agricultural equipment. But can they make a quick return on today's find?

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. The pair are in Suffolk where they find a barn filled with Porsche tractors, Ducati pushbikes and many rarer and more surprising vehicles. Moving on to Witney, they meet Lez, model builder extraordinaire, and come away with a very unusual challenge.

The Shed and Buried boys are on the move to Witney, where they meet Lez, the model builder extraordinaire, and come away with a very unusual challenge. Can Henry and Sam make a tidy profit on Lez's trike?

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace-mechanic Sam Lovegrove are in Cornwall, looking for something to buy, restore and sell on for a handsome profit. At a windswept hilltop farm they find cars, tractors and a very rare German scooter.
Paper conservator Ashleigh is tasked with restoring a 1967 James Bond film poster. And, Drew asks metalworker Ted to revamp a peculiar hardwood globe.

Drew asks Michael and Maria to repair a rare automaton from Scotland. Plus, upholsterer Ray is challenged to rescue an Edwardian slipper chair, a special kind of chair developed to seat high-class women while they put on their shoes.

The restorers are turning their hands to some old medical equipment. Sculptor Nick revives an antique anatomy model in need of urgent medical attention. Alex turns a scientific specimen cabinet into a pair of attractive cupboards.
Are moons the most likely place to find life beyond the Earth? Explore the 300 that lie within our solar system which might give an idea of the Earth's turbulent past.

Galaxies are locked in continual combat across the universe, and our own Milky Way will face its biggest opponent ever, the Andromeda Galaxy, in a titanic and deadly struggle that could create a new and unrecognizable super galaxy.

The Rosetta mission was a ground-breaking expedition to land on a comet for the very first time; special access reveals what this cutting-edge journey discovered and how these mysterious objects helped create life on Earth.
James is washed up on a remote island in the shark-infested waters of the South Pacific, as he explores how marooned crews of some of the worst shipping disasters survived.
Lockheed were tasked with creating a plane invisible to Russian radar, capable of reaching an altitude of 80,000 ft and speeds of Mach 3.2.
Emerging as a rival to Boeing's 247, the rigorously tested twin-engine DC-3 would eventually radicalise the aviation industry in 1934.
Bruce finds a picture in his attic from Dunkirk, given to him by a soldier who was there. Bruce and Hus go on a hunt for kit that tells the real story of the evacuation.
Examines how items such as graphene, the world's smallest car, force testers, and composite cans are all made.
Find out how LED tubes, chocolate peanut butter bars, and robotic medication dispensers are made and why they are in demand.
How do they turn used aluminium cans into planes and rockets? Plus, how do they carve the traditional Black Forest cuckoo clock?
How do they build the ultimate car crushing colossus? Plus, how do Lea and Perrins concoct their Worcestershire sauce?
A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.
The miraculous feats of engineering that underpin our lives, from the most basic of everyday objects to the biggest and most complex. This episode focuses on crash helmets, rubber, and wave piercing.
Experts investigate to see if the fire on Apollo 1 that killed three astronauts was a cover-up. Was it a tragic accident or part of the moon landing conspiracy?
A team of experts investigate if there was a conspiracy to fake the moon landing, and uncover a secret report on hundreds of Nazis involved in the Apollo space programme.
A series of recent UFO sightings brings Chuck Zukowski's team to Missouri, the home of the 1973 Piedmont lights incident. Armed with new evidence, they tackle whether history is repeating itself.
A Missouri man who claims UFOs are stalking him contacts Chuck and the team for help. Their investigation uncovers a dark secret which may explain this reported activity.
Examining how everyday items such as CNC assembly machines, lemon tarts, and miniature war figures are made.
An examination of how items such as chemical tank pressure vents, candy wafers, food trucks, and traditional ropes are made.
Paul Beban searches for the truth about sea monsters. He travels to Vermont's Lake Champlain to see if an unclassified creature lurks in its dark depths.
Paul investigates evil shapeshifters known as skinwalkers. He tracks these mythical beasts from the heart of the Navajo Nation to the infamous Skinwalker Ranch.
New evidence could explain a mysterious UFO encounter in the Bermuda Triangle. A team of experts investigates if aliens have visited this stretch of water.
To find the truth behind unexplained phenomena, experts follow new clues to underwater alien anomalies that some believe have ties to the lost city of Atlantis.
Henry and Fuzz head to 'Chopper Roy's' place. His vintage British motorbikes and a classic seventies sports coupé catch their eye.
Henry and Fuzz are down on the farm in Oxfordshire. They unearth mowers and tractors in Tim and Camilla's barns but end up buying something very different.

Disaster strikes a new railway bridge as a crane collapses in the middle of major construction in Italy; experts investigate and uncover a compromise in balance with improperly positioned counterweights and a manoeuvre that resulted in catastrophe.

Tragedy strikes a community when a condominium complex collapses in Miami, resulting in one of the deadliest engineering disasters in American history; experts investigate and reveal potential flaws in the structure's flat slab construction.
A crane disastrously falls across two lanes of traffic during construction work on a landmark bridge in New York City.
The Rocky Mountain National Park is famed for its landscapes and mountains. Lawn Lake Dam enlarged a natural lake into a reservoir at an almost 3000m elevation.

An unprecedented cycle of freezing and thawing causes dramatic destruction to a landmark bridge in Pennsylvania; experts investigate and reveal how a sudden surge of icy flood water buckled pier foundations weakened from years of erosion.
A rare, half-built Land Rover Series-2a gives Drew the opportunity to be able to create his dream Safari 'Landie'. With some of the accessories no longer available, the artisans step in.
A super-rare Renault 5 Gordini provides an opportunity to be able to create the best hot hatch on the market. The specialist Renault craftsmen attempt a factory perfect restoration.
Drew takes the first type of car he owned, and transforms it with a modern-day makeover. He thinks this ex-Royal Mail delivery van could be considered a perfect affordable classic.

Henry and Sam continue their Northern Ireland adventure with Gordon. The luck of the Irish strikes and they get off to a great start, with lots to marvel at. They find army vehicles, tractors and some very well-hidden Land Rovers.

Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove are in the Queen's realm as they visit a shed in the shadow of Windsor Castle. Once again both boys are happy, as there are motorcycles galore, but will they get a bargain out of Roy?

Henry and Sam continue their travel around Northern Ireland and discover lovely vintage cars, along with some modern motors. Sam loves a Sunbeam-Talbot, Henry, a lovely Ford Capri. What will they take home as their last item of the season?
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove are in the Cotswolds to visit the largest sidecar manufacturer in Britain. They uncover a rusty Lancia Aurelia and a Royal Enfield 500.
Richard visits the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, where his vertical mission includes climbing the biggest lightning conductor in the world.
Richard Hammond travels to the giant Appomattox production platform in the Gulf of Mexico, where he reveals the cutting-edge engineering behind this high-tech facility and its record-breaking drills.
Henry and Sam go to Hull to meet Mandy, whose late husband was an avid collector of classic motorbikes. There are several rare Vincents and Ariels on offer.
Henry and Fuzz are in West Sussex at Dino's mega-shed. He's got buses, vintage sports cars, rare motorbikes and oodles of motoring ephemera.

Werkstattleiter Reini bereitet eine Pistenraupe auf der Bergstation der Zugspitze für den Transport ins Tal vor. Das Fahrzeug passt mit einer Breite von 3,5 Metern nicht durch den Tunnel, deshalb wird es in Einzelteile zerlegt.

In dieser Folge werden auf 1775 Meter Höhe Waren per Helikopter angeliefert und die Besatzung des Schleppers Johannes Dalmann ist am Hamburger Hafen sehr früh auf den Beinen. Die Crew macht sich auf den Weg zu einem antriebslosen Transportschiff.

Schnee und Eiskälte fordern Matt Paxton und sein Team im Osten Washingtons heraus. Trotz blockierter Zugänge und hoher Entrümpelungskosten winken wertvolle Funde: Bronzestatuen, eine Glasvasen-Sammlung und womöglich sogar ein echter Goldklumpen.

Matt Paxton und sein Team entdecken im Bundesstaat Washington eine historische Pioniersiedlung samt Gemischtwarenladen, Bank und Sheriffsbüro. Auf der Suche nach kostbaren Wild-West-Schätzen bleiben den Profis jedoch nur drei Tage Zeit.

Drew Pritchard ist mit seinem Kumpel Teet auf dem Weg nach Norfolk. Dort besichtigen sie das denkmalgeschützte Voewood House im Arts-and-Crafts-Stil. Dessen Besitzer ist Antiquitätenexperte und bietet einige ausgewählte Stücke zum Verkauf an.

Drew und sein Kumpel Tee sind dieses Mal auf dem Weg nach Oxfordshire zum beeindruckenden Landsitz eines Multimillionärs. Viele Dinge sind unverkäuflich, doch im Keller finden die beiden einige Reisesouvenirs von vergangenen Besitzern des Anwesens.
Ein Passagier, der mit einer Maschine aus Thailand in Barcelona gelandet ist, wurde offenbar von einer kriminellen Bande ausgenutzt. Der Reisende hat laut eigener Aussage auf der Straße gelebt.
Tierquälerei für traditionelle Medizin? Die Guardia Civil hat im Koffer eines Reisenden aus China am Flughafen in Madrid Bärengallenpulver entdeckt.

In Italien leben rund 300 000 chinesische Staatsbürger. Die meisten besuchen ihr Heimatland mit einem Flug via Shanghai. Das Paar, welches die Beamten am Airport in Rom kontrollieren, kehrt ebenfalls über diese Flugroute zurück.

Am Airport in Venedig halten Grenzschützer eine Dame aus dem Senegal auf, die Koffer mit nagelneuen Kleidungsstücken und Accessoires bei sich trägt. Die Beamten hegen den Verdacht, dass die Ware nicht für den persönlichen Gebrauch bestimmt ist.

Schockraum-Alarm in Mönchengladbach-Rheydt: Ein Patient befindet sich nach einem kalten Alkoholentzug in einem kritischen Zustand. Und in Füssen muss das Behandlungsteam bei der Versorgung einer Platzwunde Schutzkleidung tragen.

Gebrochen und ausgerenkt: Eine Unfallchirurgin und zwei Pfleger versuchen in Lübeck, ein verletztes Sprunggelenk wieder in die richtige Position zu bewegen. Und ein CT-Scan zeigt bei einer anderen Patientin ein lebensbedrohliches Krankheitsbild.

Jon Lee und Dan Butler treten in Großbritannien aufs Gaspedal, denn die Beamten verfolgen ein verdächtiges Fahrzeug mit gestohlenen Kennzeichen. Eine weitere Polizeieinheit legt derweil an einer Kreuzung eine Nagelkette aus, um den Wagen zu stoppen.

Ein verdächtiger Pkw-Fahrer parkt seinen Wagen am Straßenrand und tritt zu Fuß die Flucht an. Jen Ellse und ihr Spürhund Quantum verfolgen den Mann. Der Vierbeiner ist sieben Jahre alt und geht auf die Rente zu, aber auf seine Nase ist Verlass.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.

Julia receives a call from a worried family who have discovered a very dangerous eastern brown snake under their patio. Together with two scientists, Julia wants to catch and milk the world's third most venomous snake, the dreaded coastal taipan.

Julia and her husband John must catch the second most venomous land snake in the world in a cramped laundry room. A snake has invaded a dog breeder's garden full of puppies. A woman has discovered a large python in the lake on her property.

Snake catcher Julia's first customer discovers an eastern brown snake while gardening. Then, Julia gets caught on the hand by a green tree snake hidden under a fridge. Plus, Julia and her husband John race to remove a python from a retirement home.
As the season ends, the Dirt Dogs must deliver $233,000 of gold to hit the target. Alex faces a shock resignation, and the Gold Gypsies struggle with more gold thieves.
The Dirt Dogs invest in a hard rock mining plant, while the Gold Gypsies are eager to be back in the field. However, a $20,000 excavator repair is a tough start to the season.
The Victoria Diggers may have stumbled on a million-dollar mother lode.
Renee almost died when emergency workers were unable to get through her front door. With her home now declared uninhabitable, she needs to make some changes.
Rick desperately tries to salvage his chaotic home after it was nearly destroyed by fire. Elsewhere, Linda has 60 days to declutter her house, or she'll be back on the streets.
Forrest sets off on a dangerous, shark-infested search for the extinct Caribbean monk seal. He and the crew come face-to-face with a giant tiger shark.
Josh Gates tackles history's most chilling polar adventures, including Robert Peary and Matthew Henson's brave push to the North Pole as well as Ernest Shackleton's epic survival in Antarctic ice.
Ed Stafford is joined by Donny Dust, a former US Marine intelligence officer and primitive skills expert, in a race across the wild Amazon jungle.
Laid-back Liam plans to wow his bride with a wintry white wedding. But 2000 miles away in Portugal, bride-to-be Georgia is dreaming of sun, sand and sangria.
In a bid to save money to put on a show-stopping wedding for Jay, his down-to-earth bride, Jack-the-lad Ian flies himself and his two best men 12,000 miles away to Thailand.

Rock-star turned zookeeper Scott spends under £100 on eBay for a wedding dress for his paramedic bride to be, Verity. Leaving him £1,800 to spend on life-size plastic animals for their jungle-themed wedding.
This episode follows Dippin' Dots, which sells cryogenically frozen beads of ice cream. CEO Scott Fischer wants to find out if his empire has the manpower to cope with expansion.
Anytime Fitness is a global firm, and it's the job of brand president Stacy Anderson to keep this gym giant in shape. Are all the employees on board with the planned changes?

Gordon Ramsay travels to South Philadelphia to try to turn around family-run restaurant Chiarella's, which is struggling to survive in an area full of thriving Italian establishments. That isn't the only problem facing owners Tommy and Dina Defino. Their marriage is on the verge of collapse.
Chef Ramsay returns to restaurants he tried to help in the past, such as Downcity in Providence, RI, Classic American in West Babylon, NY, and Davide in Boston to check on their progress.
Chef Ramsay revisits La Frite, Kingston Cafe, Capri and Spanish Pavilion to see if the owners succeeded in following his advice.

Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures.

Gordon confronts restaurant owners and sisters Rita and Lisa with an ultimatum. His stand-off with the siblings is just the beginning of the explosive action. He finds himself stuck in a war between the waiters, chefs and owners over who is to blame for the restaurant's failings. Can Gordon wrangle these hapless proprietors and stubborn employees back into one productive team and save the restaurant?

Jimmy Carr plays host as Jon Richardson and Johnny Vegas take on Sean Lock and Romesh Ranganathan. Josie Long joins Countdown's resident lexicographer Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Joe Wilkinson 'assists' Rachel Riley.
Joe shares jokes, paintings and some of the trolling he's been up to, such as breaking into banks, selling art for 12.5 million pounds and taking on bronze medal winning Olympians.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by celebrity guests Paul Hollywood, Dawn O'Porter, Joe Wilkinson and Rob Beckett.
Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by celebrity guests Steve Jones, David O'Doherty, Deborah Meaden, and Seann Walsh.

Gordon travels to Orange County, Southern California, to try to save an Italian restaurant from imminent destruction. Luigi's was a successful restaurant with a great reputation until Dominic decided to retire to Italy and brought in son Tony to help run it. Familial fighting and an unappetising menu of 126 items have let the restaurant down the drain. Can Gordon fix it, or is Luigi's beyond repair?

In Atlanta, Gordon helps first-time restaurant owners Richard and Jorge. Their restaurant, Park's Edge, has been open for three years but is in big trouble due to constant fighting between them, poor food and a bad vibe in the tight-knit neighbourhood. Gordon comes up with a brilliant plan to resolve the issue within the community, but then a rogue chef threatens to ruin everything.

Gordon travels to Ventura Harbour in Southern California to help a family-run Greek restaurant facing big problems that haven't taken a profit for two years. Makis Mikelatos and his wife Lynn have run the restaurant, the Greek at the Harbour, for 17 years, but Makis - who works 17 hours a day, seven days a week, and rarely takes a holiday - is exhausted, and if he doesn't slow down he's in danger of collapse.

When trying to deal with a rogue badger, Homer discovers that the area code for the Simpsons' half of Springfield (the poor half) has changed. Area code and class rivalries split Springfield in two and Homer becomes mayor of New Springfield, but his reign doesn't go well. Only The Who can save the day.

Homer and Bart take Lisa to a book fair to make up for attaching fireworks to her video. At the fair, Krusty meets his long-lost daughter, but their reconciliation doesn't go well and so Krusty does the sensible thing and turns to Homer for parenting advice.
Homer decides he doesn't need church and forms his own religion.
Lisa wins second prize in a beauty contest. When the winner is miraculously hit by lightning Lisa takes over, only to find that one of her duties is being a spokesperson for a cigarette company.

The Simpsons throw a Halloween party where Lisa, Grampa and Bart each tell a scary story. A Krusty the Clown doll comes alive and terrorises Homer, Montgomery Burns travels to Skull Island to catch giant ape 'King Homer', and Bart accidentally wakes all the human dead in Springfield.

Homer and Marge go to the school parents' evening to hear the bad news about Bart's behaviour. While they're out Bart, breaks the babysitter's teeth and Homer vows never to let him see the new `Itchy and Scratchy' movie.
When Marge gets a job at Homer's work, Mr Burns falls madly in love with her. He invites Marge over for an intimate dinner for two, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them.

When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court. The restaurant offers a peace deal: Homer can eat all the food he likes so long as people can gawk at him like a freak in return. Meanwhile, Bart falls in love with his babysitter.

The combination of Homer, his new pet pig, and a leaky silo full of excrement triggers a disaster that threatens not just Springfield but the entire world. An angry mob descends on the Simpson home, splitting the family. With Earth's fate in the balance, Homer sets out on a quest for redemption in order to save the world and earn Marge's forgiveness.
Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith get festive with bakers of Christmas past Sophie, Dan, Amelia, Linda, George and Carole, and a performance from the Citizens of the World Choir.

Britain's sharpest armchair critics review this year's Christmas TV, including the 'Strictly Christmas Special', 'Gavin & Stacey: The Finale', 'First Dates at Christmas', 'Hot Frosty', 'The Dog House at Christmas', 'Is It Cake?' and more.

Nadiya presents the very best weekend breakfasts for kicking back, relaxing and really indulging in the pleasure of the day's first meal. First up are Nadiya's delectable granola cupcakes for a delicious breakfast on the go.
A British officer and his ambulance crew discover a German spy in their midst during a harrowing desert trek through Libya in 1942.

Martin wants to run for the hills because of a tricky legal issue in Devon. Jacqui is in Eastbourne, where work is already under way at an end-of-terrace. And Dion goes to Northampton, where a smelly cellar is hard to cope with!

The team is at Wolverhampton Art Gallery. Antiques experts James Lewis and Caroline Hawley unearth a sword with a dark history and an early Moorcroft vase, while Paul Martin explores some of the region's industrial past.
Live coverage as Norway takes on Wales in the UEFA Nations League.

Stephen Watson presents full match coverage from Windsor Park as Northern Ireland take on Ukraine in the UEFA Nations League. With just two matches remaining, Northern Ireland remain firmly in contention for promotion from League B. However, Ukraine could provide a major test as Michael O'Neill's side look to bolster their position ahead of a potentially decisive final fixture. Commentary is by Thomas Kane and Stephen Craigan.

Featuring the best of the BBC's archives for this selection of 40 songs from 1985, including the likes of Elton John, Duran Duran, Foreigner, Billy Ocean, Marillion, Go West, Strawberry Switchblade and Kirsty MacColl.

Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.
Ethan Hunt and the IMF team race against time to find the Entity, a rogue artificial intelligence that can destroy mankind.
After being branded a traitor following a disastrous mission in Prague, an elite intelligence agent recruits a team of operatives to help him retrieve a computer disk that can clear his name.
IMF agent Ethan Hunt is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called Chimera after a rogue colleague kills the diseases creator and makes off with the remedy.

Now a trainer for IMF recruits, superspy Ethan Hunt is called back to active duty to confront the toughest foe he has ever faced: Owen Davian, an international broker of arms and information who is as cunning as he is ruthless. As Ethan searches for the missing agent, Davian emerges to threaten him and all that he holds dear, including the woman that he loves.

After the IMF are implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, Ethan Hunt and his new team go rogue. In order to clear their organisation's name, they track down a dangerous terrorist named Kurt Hendricks. Hendricks has gained access to Russian nuclear launch codes and is planning a strike on the United States, but will the new team be able to stop the impending disaster?

A London cocaine dealer wants to retire with his millions and his health intact, but mob boss Price has other ideas, dragging him into a set-up involving a missing junkie, a million stolen tablets of 'E' and an East European hitman.
Oli Bell and the team are at Cheltenham ahead of the Paddy Power Gold Cup meeting.
He balances books by day and bodies by night. A maths savant hiding behind a CPA desk, Christian Wolff crunches numbers for cartels and killers - until one error adds him to the equation.

An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

Jason Bourne is living in India when he is framed by Russian agent Kirill for the theft of millions from the CIA. Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

A former CIA assassin continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a 'Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, the man spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.
Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels.

It's been ten years since Jason Bourne walked away from the agency that trained him to become a deadly weapon. Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure
The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

Fired from the Anti-Villain League, Gru travels to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother. The siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who wants to take down the world.

Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.
Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But everything about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover more obstacles and more danger to overcome.

When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.
Africa's heartbeat -- the Masai Mara in Kenya each afternoon; from prowling predators to vast herds, experience Africa wilderness.
Naturalists and experts hop on a sunset safari to explore nature and interact with of some of Africa's most iconic wildlife.
Escape to nature with the sights and sounds of the wilderness.
Having different chefs from different Arab countries prepare dishes that are famous throughout the region.
If you missed the LIVE show then catch up with your sunrise safari here.
Features the Masai Mara and Kenyan National Parks; relive the wildlife encounters and sweeping plains.
Following and interacting with the real life stories of some of Africa's most iconic animals.
The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.
After an accident leading to sudden memory loss, Kathryn must re-date her boyfriend of one year, Rob, in an effort to get his memories back and remind him of his love of Christmas.
Estranged sisters Faith and Kelly reunite to fulfil their grandmother's last wish as they travel to the French Alps for Christmas, bonding and finding love along the way.
A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.
Locals compete in a Christmas bar trivia tournament at the end of the semester.
Michelle tries to get her sister a new place to live and all she has is a Christmas stocking to trade with.

Ella returns to her hometown to mend fences with her fractured family. With help from her ex-boyfriend, she encourages her family to celebrate Christmas and Kwanzaa and heal their past wounds before it's too late.
Callous bureaucrat Wikus van de Merwe helps evict a group of aliens from a Johannesburg shanty town, but has to go on the run when he becomes infected after being exposed to their technology.

Two young missionaries become ensnared in a deadly game of cat and mouse when they knock on the door of the diabolical Mr. Reed. Trapped in his home, they must turn to their faith if they want to make it out alive.
The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Fantasy

Officer K, a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

Supernatural comedy about three New York parapsychology professors who decide to set up a ghost-catching agency. Soon a storm of malevolent spirits threatens to destroy the city, and the mysterious contents of a woman's fridge suggest a paranormal Armageddon.

Released from prison, Kenna tries to reunite with her daughter, but her custodial grandparents refuse to let her see her. She soon finds unexpected compassion from a local bar owner as their secret romance gives Kenna hope for a second chance.
When a cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and drops it into the unknown, the Platt family soon discover that their survival depends on sticking together in an alien landscape.
Two aquatic misfits embark on an impossible journey to save their home.
Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

The explosive drama continues as Gordon is still in Los Angeles struggling to bring together the fragmented Saffron family and their failing restaurant, the Burger Kitchen. Last time, son Daniel nearly came to blows with the head chef, and Gordon was shocked to learn that dad Alan had taken from Daniel's inheritance, without his knowledge, to help fund the start-up of the restaurant.

Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit must save a Mushie from Muddler's clutches before Mushpie returns. When ants invade Fung and Miff's tree, our Mushlers offer for them to move in. Mush-Mush and his friends are determined to win the bark sledge race.

Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.

Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.
A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.

Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.

Greg and Pam have been together for ten years, and now they're the proud parents of two adorable twins. However, money is tight and in order to keep his family afloat, devoted nurse Greg takes a second job working for a drug company. That development doesn't sit well with Jack, whose previous suspicions regarding his hapless son-in-law soon come back in full force after learning of this development.

An LA record producer returns to his New Jersey hometown ten years after being rejected by his high-school cheerleader crush. Having made the transformation from no-hope geek to Greek god womaniser and with his friend still single, he embarks on a second seduction strategy that does not always go to plan.

When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.
A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.

Wealthy businessman, Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.
Movie, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Mystery

Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.
Movie, Romantic comedy, Music, Rock, Pop

Propelled to the top of the fashion world by a photogenic gaze he calls 'Blue Steel,' dimwitted male model Derek Zoolander thinks he's got a fourth consecutive win as Male Model of the Year in the bag. However, when his rival, Hansel, unexpectedly takes the crown, Derek is crushed. He becomes easy prey for fashion designer Jacobim Mugatu, who signs Derek to star in his 'Derelicte' fashion show, then brainwashes him to kill Malaysia's prime minister.
A special agent recruits former models Derek Zoolander and Hansel to save the world's most beautiful people from a deadly plot.
A rivalry comes about between two best friends when they each schedule their respective weddings on the same day.

Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team, Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of eco-warrior Karen from Somerset, who, after many years of living off-grid in a caravan, has struggled to adapt to living in, and looking after, a house.
This is BBC Three. Programmes start at 7.00pm.

On the planet of Ranskoor Av Kolos lie the remains of a brutal battlefield. As the Doctor, Graham, Yaz and Ryan answer nine separate distress calls, they discover the planet holds far more secrets. Who is the mysterious commander with no memory? What lies beyond the mists? Who or what are the Ux?

As the New Year begins, a terrifying evil is stirring, from across the centuries of Earth's history. As the Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz return home, they must try to overcome the threat to the planet.

Miranda has decided to prove to herself and her friends that she can officially be an adult. First by looking after a toddler, but the soft play centre is too much of a lure, and she gets stuck in a kids' tunnel. Then by hosting a dinner party for eight. It ends in inevitable chaos.

Miranda has been caring for her ill mother for five very long days. Trapped in her flat and being barked at by Penny, she is forced to think about her life regrets. Before she has the chance to tick off her bucket list she gets ill, and Tilly, Gary and Stevie offer no sympathy or help at all.
After being phone buddies for months they finally arrange a rendezvous in Leicester Square, with Stacey's best friend Nessa and Gav's pal Smithy coming along for support.

After a huge misunderstanding on the phone, Stacey thinks Gavin has finished with her. He drives to Wales to explain and ends up taking her home with him. Having never been further than Bridgend before, her trip to Essex is an eye-opening experience that ends with the biggest surprise of all.

Kate Sharp, Rachel Baker, Lucas Jones Ho, Patrick Conlan and Ravi Saini are among the 30 comics picked from almost a thousand applicants to the BBC New Comedy Awards. Tonight, they compete for a place in the grand final at Birmingham Town Hall, where one act will be named BBC New Comedian 2026. Award-winning comedian Josh Pugh hosts. Each comic performs one set for the judges: stand-up and former winner Dan Tiernan, actor and improv comic Kiell Smith-Bynoe and head judge Amy Gledhill.

The BBC's comedy talent search is back. More than a thousand comics applied, and just 30 made it through to the heats. This is the last of six, and five more acts are competing for the last place in this year's grand final. The Box at Fargo Village, Coventry, will once again be converted into the BBC's own New Comedy Club. Mancunian ray of sunshine Josh Jones is our host for the night.

It's Aks's prom night, but there are rumours about debauchery at previous proms and the threat of a stabbing. Things get more complicated when a classmate of Aks's, Ridwan, makes some unwise decisions that leave Mobeen very concerned.

Wounded Warrior Project is a charity that operates a variety of programmes and services for veterans. Join us for a look at the support that they give and hear testimonies from those who have benefitted.
An exploration of how we can confidently share Jesus in different urban contexts and build relationships with people on the margins of society.
Reverend Betty King hosts a weekly series with a cry to the Lord through prayer, worship and discussions. Born from Isaiah 58:1.
Bringing you the latest content from God TV.

The late evangelist Oral Roberts was the first to televise God's healing power at work in 1955. Today his university, ORU takes up his call to 'Go where the light is dim, and my voice is heard small'.

Nathan Morris of Shake The Nations is a British evangelist who has been on GOD TV since the Bay of the Holy Spirit Revival. He is known for his passionate messages on the Blood of Jesus and the Cross.
World-renowned evangelist Billy Graham, whose ministry spans more than 60 years, shares timeless wisdom from his expansive television archive of life-changing sermons.
Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations.
The Lord's Challenge with Joshua Daniel.
James Aladiran shares key lessons in cultivating and sustaining a passion for God in prayer.
Tree of Life Church is committed to making disciples that make disciples and are founded on the Complete Work of Christ.
Popular Bible teacher Andrew Wommack speaks on God's unconditional love and grace describing all Jesus has done for the believer.
Making church more accessible to viewers, bringing encouragement and prayer support into their homes and timely messages from John Kilpatrick who is known worldwide for the Brownsville Revival.
Two pastors and their wives experiencing burnout attend a ministry retreat centre where they start the journey in shattering their glass walls.
The best of contemporary Christian music from around the world, hosted by worship leaders Noel Robinson and Lou Fellingham.
A series on the women of the Bible (who sometimes get a bad reputation), told by awesome women.
Renowned singer songwriter Darlene Dzschech of Hope Unlimited Church talks on Wisdom in Weakness explaining how God's power is perfected through the weakness of the believer.

An anxious teacher starts a new job at an under-achieving school and quickly finds himself struggling to cope with a wild classroom assistant, a group of under-performing kids and his own very pregnant wife.
The pupils at St Bernadette's primary school are on their best behaviour for the arrival of strict new teacher Mr Shepherd. But when he loses his memory, it's up to the kids to save the day.

Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.
Movie, Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama

Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.

Honey Harman returns to work. Paired with PC Amber Johannsen, they investigate a case of criminal damage at the flat of an escort, whose glamorous lifestyle has Amber considering a career move. DC Zain Nadir is searching for a 14-year-old girl who has been chatting to a boy on the net, without realising that he's not all that he seems. PC Gabriel Kent reveals to Sheelagh Murphy that he killed the Sun Hill sniper.
Smithy investigates a car jacking case but his key witness is reluctant to talk. Meanwhile CID investigate an assault on an elderly man.
Yorkshire's HART paramedics race to help a man who has been stabbed in the back with a screwdriver, and there's a fire in a hotel resulting in a desperate search for the people inside.
A man is left with a metal spike impaled in his face after a traumatic incident on a construction site, sparking a huge rescue operation. Plus, medics help a man who was hit by a car.
A woman plunges 10 feet through the floorboards of her Sheffield home in a freak accident, and the HART team launch a major rescue operation to save her.
There's a major rescue operation on the M1 after a car towing a caravan rolls over and hits a lamp post, trapping the driver. A teacher out on his mountain bike suffers a brain injury.
The team helps a biker who has been critically injured in a crash. Meanwhile in Brontë country, a man vanishes after going for a swim in a Pennines lake, sparking a major rescue operation.
Pete helps train one of Dogs Trust's longest-staying residents and supports eleven Shih Tzus all rescued from the same household.
An eight-year-old is having an operation to straighten his squint, a man needs an ultrasound to confirm whether he has cancer and a new mum is having her wisdom teeth removed.
A 15-year-old has four baby teeth that have not fallen out and need removing, while a woman needs an operation to stop her persistent nose bleeds.
It's Christmas in the Harpers' house. Janey comes home with something unexpected and their festive cheer is left in short supply.
This year's Harper family Christmas looks like being even more fearsome than usual for Ben, as Susan is giving grandson Kenzo a third birthday party to remember.
Ben would do anything to get out of Christmas at home, Michael and Alfie make the most of an empty house, and Janey learns that it's tough being a mum.

When the Trotters go shopping, they have no idea what's in store. The hapless trio end up being accused of shoplifting when they lose their receipts. In the manager's office, things go from bad to worse as they become involved in an armed robbery. The perpetrator turns out to be someone Del sold a dodgy watch to as the Trotters spend a long night with the gunman.
Love comes into Del's life when an old flame returns to London, but Rodney and Grandad are determined to extinguish the torch that Del is carrying.
Geraldine presents a Brain of Dibley competition, and Owen offers to give a running commentary whilst gelding horses. Meanwhile, Alice is desperate to impress her future father-in-law.
Geraldine becomes a celebrity after doing 'Pause for Thought' on Terry Wogan's show. Meanwhile, the villagers prepare to unleash the Dibley Gala.
Geraldine is totally unprepared for Alice's confession on the night before her wedding, or for her first meeting with David's dashing brother.
Del's insistence that his luck will change convinces Grandad and Rodney that he will soon land them all out on the street.
Del's latest foolproof scheme for making millions, game fishing, backfires when events take an unusual turn.

With the Trotters low on cash, Uncle Albert attempts to come to their rescue. When he falls through a pub cellar door, they attempt to sue for damages. Unfortunately, Uncle Albert's pulled this stunt a few times.

Stacey and Gavin return from honeymoon to a big welcome from both families. However, Smithy seems none too happy with his best mate and Nessa has a confession to make that throws the whole evening into disarray.

Devastated by the news he's to become a father, Smithy goes AWOL. The boys finally track him down, but can he be persuaded to do the right thing? Stacey is shocked to hear of Gwen's new domestic arrangements as the prospect of living in Essex finally hits her.

During the coronavirus pandemic, Amy and Jonah try to bring order to the chaos in Cloud 9 while being pulled in multiple directions; the employees learn what it means to be "heroes" while Amy and Jonah's impending move to California looms large.
As the Cloud 9 employees prepare to send Amy and Jonah off, Mateo and Glenn attempt to organise a video tribute; Dina searches for a new best friend.

Hopeful for a few days of peace and quiet, Agatha rents a cottage in the village of Fryfam, supposedly home to mythical fairies. Before she can begin to relax, a local woman employs her to prove that her husband has been unfaithful.
Agatha is not very impressed with DCI Percy and decides to start her own investigation, and there is no rest for the sleuth when the Norfolk murder mystery takes a dramatic turn.

With the floor supervisor position available, Jonah decides to throw his hat in the ring, much to Dina's chagrin; Glenn and Mateo struggle to find the right balance in their working relationship; Garrett tries to prove he's been in love before.

On the day of Cloud 9's "In-store-vaganza," Dina finally gets the chance to step up to the plate and run the store; Garrett and Cheyenne search for a mysterious smell; Jonah finds himself excited about a new opportunity.

Katniss Everdeen finds herself in District 13 after she destroys the Games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.
A mercenary and his team cut a swath of destruction through opposing forces as they take revenge for the vicious murder of a comrade.
Join Jack Dee at the London Palladium as he guides us through his varied life and career with his customary charm and well-known gift for talking absolute rubbish.
Years after his time with Meg, Lucky finds it hard to adjust to life as a successful musician. However, it doesn't take long before Meg returns to his chaotic world.
After kicking off their search for Meg's mum in Queensland, Lucky struggles to deal with his relationship back home, while Meg is shocked by someone who followed her from Karingunna.
As Meg continues to search for her mother in Cairns, Lucky attempts to stay under the radar to avoid his past.
Lucky and Meg depart from Cairns, but the past Lucky was hoping to leave behind manages to catch up with him.
Injured in the rainforest, Lucky is desperate to make it back to civilisation, but Meg wants to continue as they get closer to locating her mother.

Just as Will and Grace are settling into the idea of raising the baby together, Will's boyfriend Vince surprises him with an announcement that will ultimately lead Will to choose between his commitment to Grace and his relationship with Vince.
Will and Grace have a decision to make. Will they remain together to raise a child? Meanwhile, will Karen ever find true happiness in Stan's absence?
The series comes to an end as Will, Grace, Jack and Karen's lives all reach a crossroads. What will become of the four friends?
Will and Grace both stumble when their political beliefs are put to the test. Jack and Karen help Will and Grace conceal their secret shame from each other, but the truth is finally revealed.
Will and Jack try to date younger guys but find it challenging. Grace and Karen experience a crisis that reveals Grace's true feelings about Karen.
When Grace gets a shock at a medical check-up, she learns that her emergency contact is not Will but her ex Leo. Jack takes a temp job as a drama teacher at a Bronx high school.
Jack unexpectedly learns that he is a grandfather, but that his grandson is being shipped off to an anti-gay 'therapy' camp. Grace and Karen behave badly with the hot new guy at work.
After Dwight gets the authority to choose a health plan for everyone, the power quickly goes to his head, infuriating his co-workers.

As downsizing rumours swirl, paranoia takes over the office. Dwight forms a 'Survivor'-esque alliance with Jim against other employees. Michael arranges a morale-boosting birthday party for Meredith, although her birthday is more than a month away.
Michael is overly confident about his team's chances in a basketball game between the office staff and the warehouse workers.

When an attractive purse saleswoman comes to the office, Michael and Dwight openly vie for her attention. Meanwhile, the corporate office allocates $1,000 as a prize for the top office salesman, but Michael spends the money on an espresso machine.
A struggling screenwriter finds himself inadvertently entangled in the criminal underworld when his knucklehead friends abduct a mobster's beloved Shih Tzu.
Recorded live at The London Palladium, Josh Widdicombe performs his stand-up show where he finally tackles the hot comedy topics of advent calendars, weddings, and the closing time of his local park.
Dom investigates a brazen burglary gang, a bizarre fraud, and a man's plan to torch a truck that backfired.
Dom investigates a crowbar attack on a jewellery shop owner and the criminals that can steal a handbag in seconds.
From trying to settle the age-old debate of cyclists versus drivers, to witnessing miraculous moments of pure luck, we've got it all caught on camera.
Bite marks in a block of cheese hold the key to catching a killer when he helps himself to a snack after a home invasion that claims the lives of three members of the Laitner family.
A profile of a murderer and rapist known as 'The Truck Stop Killer', who targeted hitchhikers and sex workers in a horrific string of crimes that may have claimed the lives of dozens of victims.
In 1983, Arthur Hutchinson took the lives of three members of the Laitner family after breaking into their South Yorkshire home, but the police eventually caught up with the murderer.
After Gordon Wardell makes an emotional appeal to find his wife's killers, police soon realise they must look closer to home as they dig deeper into suspicions about Carol Wardell's husband.
In 2017, joggers found the body of Sinead Wooding, a young wife and mother-of-four brutally murdered by her abusive, controlling husband and an accomplice in her Leeds family home.

Following up a missing person's report, Detective John Cabrera visits the boarding house of Dorothea Puente, a friendly and cooperative woman. After Cabrera discovers a body in her backyard, Puente goes on the run.
While Detective John Cabrera digs into the dark part of Dorothea Puente, she is plotting her next move from a Los Angeles motel room until a tip-off leads to her being arrested.
When the much-loved grandmother Maire Rankin is found murdered on Christmas Day in 2008, suspicion falls on relatives and neighbours as police investigators seek to find the killer.
In 1986, self-proclaimed pastor Gary Heidnik kidnapped, tortured and raped six women in Philadelphia, brutally murdering two. Two of the victims recount the horrors of surviving the monster preacher.
Dubbed the 'Grindr Killer', serial rapist Stephen Port murdered at least four men between 2014 and 2015 by using a variety of online gay social networks to find his victims.

In Italy, Allied forces are stalled in the mountains south of Rome, unable to break through the German lines at Monte Cassino. The killing goes on all winter and spring as the enemy manages to fight off repeated Allied attacks. A risky landing at Anzio ends in utter failure; thousands of Allied troops, including Babe Ciarlo of Waterbury, are exposed to enemy fire and unable to advance for months.

In the early hours of June 6, 1944 - D-Day - the invasion of France begins. A million and a half men take part. It is the bloodiest day in American history since the Civil War. The Allies succeed in tearing a 45-mile gap in Hitler's vaunted Atlantic Wall. By day's end more than 150,000 men have landed on French soil, and more men and more equipment and supplies are coming ashore every hour.

In the summer of 1944 the Allies are bogged down in the hedgerows of Normandy, while in the Pacific, US Marines fight their costliest battle to date on the island of Saipan. By mid-August, the Germans are in full retreat out of France, and on 25 August, after four years of Nazi occupation, Paris is liberated.

By September 1944 on the Western Front, American and British troops massed on the German border are desperately short of fuel. Allied commanders gamble on a risky scheme to drop thousands of airborne troops behind enemy lines in Holland, In the Pacific, General MacArthur is poised to invade the Philippines at Leyte. The fighting drags on for more than two months in one of the most brutal and unnecessary campaigns in the Pacific.

In the late fall of 1944 American soldiers suffer terrible losses when they are ordered into the forbidding and fiercely defended terrain of the Hurtgen Forest and the Vosges Mountains. In the Central Pacific, to the delight of audiences back home, General MacArthur returns to the island of Leyte, but months of bloody fighting lie ahead before the Philippine Islands - and the people imprisoned on them - can be liberated.

Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dolgan survive by herding reindeer.

More kinds of plants are crammed together in the tropical rainforests than anywhere else on Earth. The result is astonishing beauty and intense competition, a plant battleground. Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. El desprecio por la vida que muestran los asesinos en serie. Los psicópatas y sádicos rara vez muestran arrepentimiento o empatía por las vidas que destruyen.

Whitmer chronicles his chaotic adolescence, from skateboarding tales to ruining a Benihana birthday party.

Comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first stand-up special; a performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another, from Trader Joe's to Oreos, NPR and dog breeds; Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines and more.

Debuting original material about the shared experiences as humans, tackling topics like family, religion and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity; expecting an original and unforgettable experience, filmed at the Wiltern Theater in Los Angeles.
Equal parts stand-up, documentary and rock concert, Adam Pally plays with the truth and his guitar in a one-time-only performance.

Ramy Youssef returns to the stage to offer his unique reflections on a divided world, the unexpected perils of charitable giving, the 2024 presidential election, prayer, and a childhood book report that changed the course of his life.
Maia hyper-fixates on the state of her life in Los Angeles while attempting to impress her boss, Alyssa; her carefully laid plans are upended by the surprise arrival of her chaotic friend Tallulah.
After reconciling, Maia and Tallulah step into their new roles as manager and client while tackling an increasingly erratic situation.
A tight-knit friend group gathers after years apart, navigating the complexities of ambition, relationships, and how time has changed them.
At a party, Maia and Alani have a once-in-a-lifetime encounter, Tallulah gets roped into making content and Charlie meets someone new.
While Maia and Dylan get an unexpected dinner invitation from Alyssa, Charlie is charmed by Lukas and Alani teaches Tallulah to drive.

When her husband suddenly dumps her, longtime and dedicated housewife Deanna turns regret into reset by going back to college. Unfortunately, Deanna winds up at the same school as her less-than-thrilled daughter. Plunging headlong into the campus experience, the outspoken new student soon begins a journey of self-discovery while fully embracing all the fun, freedom and frat boys that she can handle.
Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance.
A detailed look at the final five years of David Bowie's life when he not only began producing music again, but returned to the core and defining themes of his career.
An all-encompassing tribute, brimming with archival footage and candid moments, Anka, still going strong, offers in his own words a vivid glimpse into his remarkable life and enduring legacy.

Mumble (Elijah Wood) the penguin, now called the Master of Tap, has an unusual problem: Erik, his son, is reluctant to dance. Erik runs away from home and encounters the Mighty Sven (Hank Azaria) -- a penguin that can fly. Poor Mumble can't compete with Erik's unusual new role model. But, when the world is shaken by powerful forces, Erik gets a chance to see his father's true colors as Mumble gathers all creatures great and small to set things right again.
Movie, Animated, Children, Adventure, Musical, Comedy

In 1843 London, author Charles Dickens finds himself in financial trouble after writing three unsuccessful novels in a row. Desperate for a hit, Dickens relies on real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination to bring Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today.

Ten-year-old Gloria and her recently widowed grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home. They try to keep the secret while figuring out why the reindeer has appeared, and longstanding rifts within the family are healed along the way.

Finally alone for the holidays, Luther (Tim Allen) and Nora Krank (Jamie Lee Curtis) plan to eschew the Christmas traditions and take a cruise in the Caribbean instead. This doesn't sit well with their Christmas-obsessed neighbors Vic Frohmeyer (Dan Aykroyd) and Walt Scheel (M. Emmet Walsh), who are determined to win the annual "best decorated street" competition, and the Kranks soon find themselves social outcasts because of their lack of Christmas spirit.

Six years after their last adventure, stoner pals Harold (John Cho) and Kumar (Kal Penn) have grown apart and found new friends. As each is busy making holiday preparations, a mysterious package mistakenly arrives on Kumar's doorstep. Unfortunately, Kumar's attempt to redirect the package to Harold goes up in smoke -- along with a prize Christmas tree belonging to Harold's father-in-law. The pair's journey across New York City to find a replacement tree threatens to blow Christmas Eve sky-high.
Una estrella del pop en ascenso se enfrenta a la presión de la fama mientras prepara su primera gira en estadios.

Tras una serie de muertes que sacuden a la comunidad, Wilson se empeña en descubrir la verdad, mientras acusan injustamente a Delano. Temiendo una guerra, Martinha recurre a un viejo conocido para restablecer el orden: Sandro Cenoura.
Abby, una estudiante de secundaria, describe lo que ella y su mamá han aprendido sobre las personas cuando limpian sus hogares.
Bertha regresa a un hogar en el que reina la frialdad. Las aspiraciones profesionales de Peggy entran en conflicto con la gente de Newport. Agnes concede una entrevista a regañadientes.

El jefe de una compañía, culpable de fraude, colabora con las autoridades, y a él y su familia los reubican, mediante el programa de protección de testigos, en un barrio residencial del sur del país. El problema es que es el barrio de Madea.

Un ambicioso joven que acaba de salir del Ejército acepta un trabajo como barman en un local nocturno de Nueva York para poder costear sus estudios. Enseguida se convierte en la atracción del lugar y encara un nuevo plan: abrir su propio bar.

Una mujer lleva a sus dos hijos a pasar el fin de semana a la casa de alta tecnología que construyó su difunto padre en una zona remota y en la que cuatro criminales irrumpen en busca de dinero. Cuando los niños se convierten en rehenes, ninguna trampa, truco o ser humano se interpondrá en su misión más importante, salvar a su familia.
Una joven se ve envuelta en el gran conflicto entre la riqueza tradicional y la nueva riqueza en la alta sociedad neoyorquina de finales del siglo XIX.
Owen y Claire regresan a la isla para salvar a los dinosaurios de un volcán a punto de erupción. Juntos descubren un extraño avance evolutivo y una conspiración que amenaza a todo el planeta.
Movie, Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Thriller
A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him.
When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back.
